integrity: The universal classifications follow from the written proof. The standalone program supplies finite checks only; it is not a computer certification of all integers.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted undirected wheels, binary choices, all-rebel or exactly one-conformist rims, labeled pure strategy profiles. No conclusions for arbitrary type words, random graphs, weighted games, mixed equilibria, or dynamics. Perrin-cycle MIS correspondence is prior art. Uninspected full texts of related Shen–Lin graph-fashion papers leave priority risk; independent literature validation and scientific audit have not been performed.
title: Exact equilibrium phase diagram for conformist–rebel fashion games on wheels
